name: 地図で選んだ施設の写真付きパネル
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0048 地図で選んだ施設の写真付きパネル. Input1 is exact ORIGINAL scoped sheet crop including the large aerial tile; input2 original skyline crop, input3 original partially visible lower photo crop. All source photography/crops are PROTECTED: reuse unchanged, no redraw, no new scenery or recrop. Input4 our mock is SECONDARY Japanese content/control layout, with inaccurate icons/stars; input5 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot supplies authoritative directions diamond and unsaved bookmark icon. Originals control icon anatomy, stroke/optical weight, fine spacing and visible states; do not copy mock paperplane, plain share arrow or document website glyph.
Create one compact near-square white rounded bottomsheet on #FFFFFF, subtle neutraledge/softshadow. Center small gray handle. Heading exact "代々木の公園" MeiryoBold20/28. Rating row "4.7" then FOUR GOLD full stars and one gold/gray halfstar as original, then "(14,868件)". Do not copy five full green stars from mock. Next "公園・車いす対応" with original ACTIVE wheelchair glyph, slate outline/solid anatomy accurately referenced, not generic person. Next "営業中・22:00に終了": only 営業中 green, time neutral. Supporting type MeiryoRegular14/24 and metadata12/16, tracking0. Preserve hierarchy, no allbold.
Keep native FOUR controls: circular primary icon-only directions action with smooth forestgreen #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E and WHITE diamond with bent-right-turnarrow cutout as input5; white secondary pills "保存" with unsaved outlined bookmark frominput5, "共有" with source square-and-upward-arrow share icon, "公式" with original source globe website glyph. Secondary glyphs consistent slate#526173, inklabels, neutralborder. Restore source top-right share-circle and gray draghandle. No invented actions, metrics or English productcopy.
Below preserve EXACT asymmetric photo mosaic: large left aerial tile; right tall skyline tile and lower partialblue-sky tile cut at existing extent. Use original input1 aerial and input2/3 pixels at same proportions and crop. Upper-left opaque label on aerial exact "周辺を見渡す"; label may become forestgreen with white type but must COVER original English label so hidden imagery is not invented. Preserve source crop boundaries and any baked-in source overlay coverage; do not reconstruct hidden photographic content. No full replacement park scenes or landmarks. Photos are media, never recolor green. Native content is an existing example adaptation, no real-world claims. No map above sheet, device chrome or unrelated Google page. High-resolution frontal component, modestwhitemargin. Accentdecision: golden rating preserves meaning; green status and primary route only; white/slate secondary controls. Raster only.
reviewNotes: Original fullsheet and three photo crops opened separately; native glyph/star inaccuracies corrected in prompt. Output has Japanese content, directions/bookmark/share/globe and fractional stars, but protected photographs/crops changed and body/metadata too bold. Secondary icons too dark, wheelchair blue. Source-media and typography correction required.
